summary: The DGA alert: an inline message box in an info, success, warning or error tone, with an optional title and an optional close button.

inputs.name: variant
inputs.description: The tone: colours, icon and live role.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Optional bold first line (translated); it also names the alert. A static title="..." adds no tooltip.

inputs.name: dismissLabel
inputs.description: Accessible name of the close button (translated); without it the alert has no close button.

outputs.name: dismissed
outputs.description: Emitted once when the user closes the alert; the alert then hides itself.

a11y: Error and warning render role=alert (announced at once); info and success render role=status (announced politely). Render the alert when the message appears so it is announced. The title, when present, names the alert through aria-labelledby. The variant icon is decorative. The close button is a native button named by dismissLabel. Logical CSS: the accent border sits on the inline start and the close button on the inline end in both RTL and LTR.
